description:
A frozen window around a fault: a header plus the samples and events of the window.

The header identifies the cell and the device that faulted, the fault code and instant,
and the versions and package hash in force so a record can be tied back to what was running.
The window is `[at_ns - pre_ns, at_ns + post_ns]`; `samples` and `events` fall inside it,
ordered by `t_ns`.

at_ns.description: Instant of the fault, in nanoseconds
at_ns.title: At Ns

daemon_version.description: Daemon version that wrote the record
daemon_version.title: Daemon Version

package_hash.description: Hash of the deployed package, when known
package_hash.title: Package Hash

post_ns.description: Window kept after the fault, in nanoseconds
post_ns.title: Post Ns

pre_ns.description: Window kept before the fault, in nanoseconds
pre_ns.title: Pre Ns
